verdict.rationale: Zoom Scribe is a speech-to-text API covering fast, batch, and live transcription, diarization, vocabulary, and text polishing. It does not act as an agent or tool-calling client, so plugging MCP servers in to use their tools is a category error for this product type. The truncated 'MCP C…' entry in Zoom's llms.txt refers to Zoom documentation listings, not to Scribe consuming MCP servers as a client, so it does not make the axis apply.
